notes: All 12 views inspected. Narrow painted step-back cabinet with four open upper shelves, a bare wood counter, a single drawer and a lower cupboard with a knob. Worn blue paint over exposed timber is consistent across the front and sides, and the shelves have real thickness. Deliberately simple at 966 triangles, which keeps the silhouette and panel edges clean.
limitations: Very low triangle count (966); edges will look faceted in extreme close-up.
The back is unfinished bare board, as on real wall-standing furniture; do not place it free-standing in a room.
Not rigged: the drawer and cupboard door do not open.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
